player_prompt.intro:
I chuan Blackjack khelh i tum a, dealer nen.
I tum ber chu point 21 hnaih ber tura khelh a ni.
I vawiin, '[Hit]' tih hi card dang lak tur a ni, '[Stand]' tih hi i neih tawh hi i humhim tur a ni.
